crosses.title: Holes & Stars — Keep neighboring gaps while the line gains openings
notes: Two equal in-phase points have a neighboring gap of one-fifth mask unit. Normalized point intensity at the center is one; the first horizontal null is at u two-and-a-half.
Four equal in-phase points keep the one-fifth neighboring gap. The center remains one, but the first horizontal null moves to u one-and-a-quarter.
Eight points keep the same neighboring gap and center intensity. The first horizontal null is at u five-eighths. More points narrow this central peak without changing the point-opening patch.
crosses.facts: Ideal equal in-phase point intensity normalized by N squared. N=2/4/8,gap d=.2,centered x_i=.2*(i-(N-1)/2),y0; center I=1 and first null u=1/(N*d)=2.5/1.25/.625. Source phase/strength/illumination,finite opening shape/width/height and probe/profile unchanged. Claims expressly ideal point case. Max8 existing mask capacity; x sliders .01 represent all coordinates.
